v0.29.4 修复接口防刷失效 + 一处「自伤」+ 版本号对齐（只发网页线，App 无需更新）

· 修复接口防护整体失效：线上用于「防脚本刷接口」的计数器此前被一次部署意外清掉，导致防护实际不生效——生成类接口可被脚本无限调用。现已把该配置写进构建文件（不再依赖控制台手工设置），并经压测确认真的生效。
· 顺手修掉一处「自伤」：失效期间使用的备用计数方式，每次请求都会往存储里写一条记录，把每天的写入额度占掉约三分之二（实测 630 条记录里 426 条是它写的），极端情况下会导致**学习进度同步失败**。已改为纯内存方式，不再占用额度；同时把「防护降级」变成一条可见告警——静默失效才是它活了这么久的原因。
· 版本号对齐：项目配置文件里的版本号（0.3.59）与其他五处（0.29.3）长期不一致，相差 28 个版本，容易让人读错。已统一，并纳入发版自动同步，以后不会再脱节。
· 本次只发网页线，**App 无需更新**。学习进度、连胜、复习计划与今日路径全部保留，无需重新设置。
noteEn:
v0.29.4 Fixed a broken abuse-protection rule + a self-inflicted quota leak + version alignment (web-only release; no app update needed)

· Fixed the API protection failing open: the counter that guards the app's endpoints against scripted abuse was silently wiped by an earlier deployment, so the protection was effectively off and the generation endpoints could be called without limit. The binding is now declared in the build file (no more hand-editing in a dashboard) and verified by a load test.
· Fixed a self-inflicted quota leak: while that protection was down, its fallback wrote a storage record on every single request, eating roughly two thirds of the daily write allowance (measured: 426 of 630 records). In a bad case that would have broken **progress syncing**. The fallback is now in-memory only, and a degraded state now raises a visible alert instead of failing silently — silently failing is exactly why this went unnoticed for so long.
· Version alignment: the version in the project config file (0.3.59) had drifted 28 releases away from the other five places (0.29.3). It is now unified and synced automatically on every release.
· This is a web-only release — **no app update needed**. Your progress, streak, review schedule and today's path are all preserved; nothing needs setting up again.
